title: Cisco releases security updates for multiple products
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-317.051520: TT-CSIRT ADVISORY – CISCO RELEASES SECURITY UPDATES FOR MULTIPLE PRODUCTS
leadParagraph: Cisco has released security updates to address vulnerabilities in multiple products. A remote attacker could exploit some of these vulnerabilities to take control of an affected system.
contentHtml:
Cisco has released security updates to address vulnerabilities in multiple products. A remote attacker could exploit some of these vulnerabilities to take control of an affected system.

The Trinidad and Tobago Cyber Security Incident Response Team (TTCSIRT) encourages users and administrators to review the Cisco Security Advisories page and apply the necessary updates.

For further reference please review the following links below:

https://tools.cisco.com/security/center/publicationListing.x?product=Cisco&sort=-day_sir#~Vulnerabilities
